verdict.rationale: v0 supports starting from existing code via GitHub import ('Start with existing files (fast, no tokens)', 'Import from GitHub') and cloning pages from screenshots/Figma, which lets a founder skip a blank prompt. However there is no evidence of a curated template gallery or community-project marketplace to browse and start from, unlike many builder tools. missing for 10: a discoverable template/community-project gallery, evidence of curated starter templates, and independent confirmation that GitHub import serves as a true template-start experience.
